title: Compare Drift Across Sensor Configurations
summary: `compare_drift(estimated, reference, valid, baseline)` estimated(C,N,3),1<=C<=64,1<=N<=8192,C*N<=262144; reference(N,3),valid(C,N), baseline builtinint0..C-1. Positions meters, already same world frame and matched timestamps. Use ONLY common evidence common=all(valid,axis0) for every configuration. Return common(N),countint,errors(C,N) with NaN outsidecommon,rmse(C),endpoint(C),improvement(C),best int. Errors Euclidean position norm; RMSE=sqrt(mean(errors²)); endpoint uses highest common sample index, not arbitrary last valid perconfig; improvement=baseline_rmse-rmse inmeters. Best minRMSE first-index ties; ifno common count0,allmetricsNaN,best-1. No posthoc alignment, interpolation, or assertion that better absolute error is solely less accumulated drift. Example reference[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]], estimated0=reference,estimated1=reference+[1,0,0],allvalid,baseline1=>rmse[0,1],endpoint[0,1],improvement[1,0],best0. Examplevalid[[True,False],[False,True]]=>no common. Comparison intentionally sacrifices coverage to prevent missing-data advantages.
